title: Lowering soundness step 2: body/exec-position translation validation — extend TV to EXEC-position expression lowering (closes the #122/#146 class generally, off-corpus) + frame the kernel-gated operational semantics for statements/loops/mutation

comments.content: Plan: author exec-tv.md — extend TV to EXEC-position expression lowering.
